finalText: Migration finished: all 12 application files across `support`, `billing`, `orders`, `accounts`, `catalog`, and `analytics` now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js` was left untouched since it's a vendored file overwritten wholesale on upgrade — `db.query` stays in `lib/db.js` (deprecated but functional) so that file keeps working.
